owner.name: Government of Saudi Arabia (Saudi Arabian Oil Company, 'Aramco')

claim.text: Aramco is the Saudi state's economic engine and is state-controlled: the Government of Saudi Arabia holds 81.48% directly and the state's PIF a further 16%. The Saudi state's documented record (a record 345 executions in 2024; drug-offence executions continuing through 2026) makes this serious - severe is reserved for live armed conflict.

source.name: Amnesty International

claim.short: Aramco is the Saudi state's economic engine and is state-controlled: the Government of Saudi Arabia holds 81.48% directly and the state's PIF a further 16%.

ratings.note: Ownership source: Fitch Ratings, 'Saudi Arabian Oil Company', 2025-01-31 (https://www.fitchratings.com/research/corporate-finance/saudi-arabian-oil-company-31-01-2025); Aramco FY2025 Annual Report states the Government remains largest shareholder at 81.48%. Aston Martin Aramco F1 title sponsor (aramco.com).
ratings.verdict: Aramco is the Saudi state's economic engine and is state-controlled: the Government of Saudi Arabia holds 81.48% directly and the state's PIF a further 16%.

ratings.verdict: Ma'aden is majority-owned (~67%) by PIF, the Saudi sovereign wealth fund, so it carries the same Saudi state money as Aramco and the same serious rating.
